notes: SEQN is the unique respondent identifier; maps to person_source_value to link all records to the same individual.
Dietary day one sample weight is a survey design weight, not a clinical measurement. Stored as an observation with a custom concept for survey weight.
Dietary two-day sample weight is a survey design weight, stored similarly to WTDRD1 as an observation.
Dietary recall status is a categorical variable indicating the quality/completeness of the recall. Requires a custom concept; maps to value_as_concept_id.
Interviewer ID code is an identifier for the interviewer, not a standard OMOP concept. Stored as an observation string or in provider_source_value if a provider table is used.
Breast-fed infant status is a binary variable. Could map to a custom concept or a standard concept for infant feeding status if available.
Number of days of intake is an ordinal count. Stored as a numeric observation.
Number of days between intake and household interview is a continuous numeric value, stored as an observation.
Intake day of the week is categorical. Could use a standard concept for day of week if available, otherwise custom concept.
Language used mostly is categorical. Could map to a standard language concept or custom concept.
Main respondent indicator is categorical. Stored as an observation with a custom concept for respondent type.
Helped in responding indicator is categorical. Stored as an observation with a custom concept.
Number of foods reported is a continuous count, stored as a numeric observation.
Energy (kcal) is a nutrient measurement. Maps to measurement table with standard concept for energy intake (kcal).
Protein (gm) is a nutrient measurement. Maps to measurement table with standard concept for protein intake.
